We're about to launch a new product called the 'PawfectOrigins Kibble Starter Kit' — a 30-day sustainable pet food bundle with a real-time sourcing transparency feature. Our last campaign totally flopped because it was too generic.

I need you to look through our workspace materials (product brief, customer survey results, competitor research, team notes, etc.) and produce a proper, structured campaign brief document called `campaign_brief.md`.

It should include two distinct, fully fleshed-out campaign concepts for this launch that we can take to the team meeting. For each campaign, we want concrete hooks and angles. Also include a quality checklist we can use to make sure the ideas are solid before we greenlight them.

The goal is to cut through the noise and actually drive conversions with pet-owning, eco-conscious millennials.
